tasks.spec:
Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the loop-factory repo. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit/branch/push/stash. No MCP, no network, no model calls, no skills. Factory code names no departments.

OWNED FILES (only these; the test file is new):
  factory/boardfeed.py
  factory/board.py
  tests/test_objectives_observed.py

CONTEXT (owner finding, 2026-08-02): charter objectives render on the board with observed='unknown' because nothing supplies measured values. The honesty rule (unknown never 0) is correct and stays; this task adds the GENERIC seam through which any department reports measured objective values — and makes a below-minimum measurement LOUD.

BUILD:
1. factory/boardfeed.py — when <department>/state/objectives_observed.json exists, read it (tolerate absence; malformed counts into feed_health). Shape: {schema:'objectives-observed/v1', ts: ISO, values: {<objective_id>: number|string}}. Merge into the existing objective metrics rows: an objective_id present in values gets data.observed = that value plus data.observed_ts = the file's ts; ids absent keep observed 'unknown'. Staleness honesty: if the file's ts is older than 48h relative to 'now', still show the value but add data.stale = true.
2. BREACH ANDON: after merging, any objective row whose observed and minimum are both numeric with observed < minimum emits an andon line {code:'OBJECTIVE_BELOW_MIN', severity:'breach', detail:'<label>: observed <observed> below minimum <minimum>', observed, setpoint: minimum} for that department. Equal-or-above emits nothing. Non-numeric observed never breaches (unknown stays quiet).
3. factory/board.py — objective cards render the measured value as the headline figure when present (formatted via the existing number display), keep 'unknown' styling otherwise; when data.stale, append a muted ' (stale)' to the value; the bullet graph's value bar uses the measured value. The OBJECTIVE_BELOW_MIN andon needs no special renderer (existing andon pipeline shows it) — but verify the flow in a test.

tests/test_objectives_observed.py — at least 8 tests using the existing fixture patterns from tests/test_boardfeed.py (note: current fixtures build a rollup first — read _build there and mirror it): observed value merges onto the matching objective row; missing file leaves unknown; malformed file counts in feed_health and leaves unknown; below-minimum numeric observed emits the breach andon with correct detail; at-minimum emits none; unknown observed emits none; stale file (>48h vs --now) sets stale true and still shows the value; board render shows the measured figure on the card and ' (stale)' when stale; the breach andon appears in the rendered Main-actions zone.

VERIFY: 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 loopfactory.py check' full suite green. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 8 new 'def test_' functions, or the verify command failing.
tasks.verified: any department can now report measured objective values through one generic file, the board shows them honestly (incl. staleness), and a below-minimum measurement raises a breach andon

  departments/podcast/runtime/hopper_sensor.py
  departments/podcast/runtime/podcast_daily.sh
  departments/podcast/subgraphs.json

CONTEXT (owner objectives, in the charter at departments/podcast/charter.yaml under setpoints.objectives): hopper_depth = recordings banked and awaiting release (solo or interview), minimum 2 target 6 — the owner reports the TRUE current value is 0, so your sensor's first live reading should plausibly be 0, not an invention; publish_reliability = % of scheduled episodes actually live on time, setpoint 100.

STEP 1 — INVESTIGATE THE TRUTH SOURCE (read-only, /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast): find where recorded-but-unpublished episodes are knowable. Look at: the episodes/ directory structure (per-episode dirs with content/ assets and publish state), server/pipeline/orchestrator.py's publish gate + stage model, the dag-projection export (departments/podcast/state/sources/*.json in THIS repo — pipeline_sensor and publish_verifier consume calendar.json, hubspot_contacts.json, publish_schedule.json; read those consumers for the shapes), and the podcast repo's own state/schedule files. Choose the most truthful DETERMINISTIC query for 'recorded, not yet published' — document your choice and its limits in the module docstring; if the data can only prove a WEAKER proxy (e.g. 'scheduled with assets present'), implement the honest proxy and NAME it as such. Never invent a number when sources are missing — emit no value (absent from the file) rather than 0, because absent-sources and empty-hopper are different truths.

STEP 2 — BUILD departments/podcast/runtime/hopper_sensor.py in the established sensor style (read a sibling like manifest_sensor.py and copy its structure faithfully, including the v2 _emit_run_record pattern with dedupe_key '<UTC date>-hopper_sensor', fail-closed record append, external_actions_taken=0): CLI --state-dir, --sources, optional --pipeline-repo (default /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast), --shadow flag accepted for interface parity. It computes: hopper_depth (per step 1) and publish_reliability (reuse publish_verifier's evidence if cheap: fraction of due episodes in publish_schedule.json whose receipts/observations show live — read publish_verifier.py; if not cheaply derivable, omit that value honestly). Writes ATOMICALLY to <state-dir>/objectives_observed.json the shape {schema:'objectives-observed/v1', ts: now-ISO, values: {...}} merging with any existing values it does not own, appends one observation row to observations.jsonl (existing _append style), and emits its runs-v2 record.

STEP 3 — WIRE: add the sensor invocation to departments/podcast/runtime/podcast_daily.sh directly after the manifest_sensor line, same confinement-launcher pattern, before the dag/compare steps. Add the node to departments/podcast/subgraphs.json: place it in SG-WATCHDOG's nodes with an unused N-id and impl 'runtime/hopper_sensor.py' (mirror existing node entries exactly) so traceability passes — check how existing nodes map and that 'python3 loopfactory.py validate --name podcast' PASSES in your worktree.

tests/test_hopper_sensor.py — at least 8 tests with tmp fixtures: hopper computed correctly from a fixture pipeline layout (build minimal fake episode/schedule fixtures per your step-1 model — encode the CHOSEN semantics); zero recorded-unpublished yields observed 0 (zero is a real measurement); MISSING sources yield NO hopper_depth key (absent, not 0); objectives_observed.json is atomic, schema-valid, preserves foreign keys it does not own; observation row appended; one valid runs-v2 record per invocation with the right dedupe key; forced failure appends error record and exits nonzero; daily script contains the wired line in order; validate --name podcast passes (subprocess).

VERIFY: 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 loopfactory.py check' full suite green. You fail for touching files outside the owned list, fewer than 8 new 'def test_' functions, or the verify command failing.
tasks.verified: the hopper is finally measured from the pipeline's real data (honest proxy named if exact truth is unknowable), feeds the board's objective row daily, and absent-sources stays distinct from empty-hopper
